scraped_items.description: Rows of scraped products; product_url is unique; product_key may be NULL.

scraped_price_history.description: Raw per-URL price timeline (inserted by triggers on scraped_items insert/update).

scraped_price_history_key.description: Per product_key + shop price timeline (inserted by triggers when product_key present).

scraped_best_offers.description: Computed best offer per product_key recorded_at timestamp.
scraped_best_offers.notes: Current behavior: compute_and_store_best_offers inserts a single winner per product_key (lowest price, tie-break by shop_id).

triggers.name: trg_scraped_items_price_insert
triggers.action: INSERT INTO scraped_price_history (product_url, price, scraped_at) VALUES (new.product_url, new.price, new.scraped_at)

triggers.name: trg_scraped_items_price_update
triggers.on: AFTER UPDATE OF price ON scraped_items WHEN new.price IS NOT old.price
triggers.action: INSERT INTO scraped_price_history (product_url, price, scraped_at) VALUES (new.product_url, new.price, new.scraped_at)

triggers.name: trg_scraped_items_key_price_insert
triggers.on: AFTER INSERT ON scraped_items WHEN new.product_key IS NOT NULL AND new.price IS NOT NULL
triggers.action: INSERT INTO scraped_price_history_key (product_key, shop_id, price, scraped_at) VALUES (new.product_key, new.shop_id, new.price, new.scraped_at)

triggers.name: trg_scraped_items_key_price_update
triggers.on: AFTER UPDATE OF price ON scraped_items WHEN new.product_key IS NOT NULL AND new.price IS NOT old.price
triggers.action: INSERT INTO scraped_price_history_key (product_key, shop_id, price, scraped_at) VALUES (new.product_key, new.shop_id, new.price, new.scraped_at)

sample_queries.best_price_per_shop_for_key: SELECT shop_id, shop_name, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM scraped_items WHERE product_key = ? AND stock = 1 AND price IS NOT NULL AND scraped_at >= ? GROUP BY shop_id, shop_name;
sample_queries.min_price_per_key: SELECT product_key, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM scraped_items WHERE product_key IS NOT NULL AND product_key != '' AND price IS NOT NULL AND stock = 1 AND scraped_at >= ? GROUP BY product_key;
sample_queries.latest_best_offer_per_key: SELECT b.* FROM scraped_best_offers b JOIN (SELECT product_key, MAX(recorded_at) AS last_rec FROM scraped_best_offers GROUP BY product_key) m ON b.product_key = m.product_key AND b.recorded_at = m.last_rec ORDER BY b.recorded_at DESC LIMIT ?;
sample_queries.list_product_keys_with_sample: SELECT s.product_key, s.product_name AS sample_product_name, s.product_url AS sample_product_url, s.shop_name AS sample_shop_name FROM scraped_items s JOIN (SELECT product_key, MAX(scraped_at) AS last_scraped FROM scraped_items WHERE product_key IS NOT NULL AND product_key != '' GROUP BY product_key) m ON s.product_key = m.product_key AND s.scraped_at = m.last_scraped ORDER BY s.product_key LIMIT ?;

notes: Prices are stored as integer currency units. Gezatek scraper now truncates cents (no rounding). Triggers keep price history in sync. compute_and_store_best_offers records one winner per product_key by design.
